dbqueries.dbquery: insert into tp_appointments_notifications ( appointment_id, appointment_subject, appointment_from_date, appointment_to_date, appointment_created_by, applicant_id, position_id, position_step_id, appointment_attendee, appointment_from_date_new, appointment_to_date_new, appointment_attendee_new, appointment_notify_type, appointment_processed, appointment_date_created, appointment_date_modified, remind_me, remind_attendee,interview_mode,details_interview_mode) values ( ?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)

SELECT notification_id, appointment_id, appointment_subject, appointment_from_date, appointment_to_date, appointment_created_by, applicant_id, position_id, position_step_id, appointment_attendee, appointment_from_date_new, appointment_to_date_new, appointment_attendee_new, appointment_notify_type, appointment_processed, appointment_date_created, appointment_date_modified, appointment_sequence_no, remind_me, remind_attendee,interview_mode,details_interview_mode FROM tp_appointments_notifications WHERE appointment_processed=? ORDER BY notification_id
UPDATE tp_appointments_notifications SET appointment_processed=?, appointment_processed_date=now() WHERE notification_id=?

update tp_appointments_notifications t1 inner join (select count(*) as cnt,notification_id from tp_appointments_notifications where appointment_id= ? and notification_id < ?) as t2 on (t1.notification_id = t2.notification_id) set appointment_sequence_no = t2.cnt where t1.notification_id = ?
